_note: The reference stills Kaggle paints when style_bible/refs/ lacks them (gate 1). Each prompt follows style.txt. 'from' paints the still as an edit of an approved one, so faces and objects stay the same across the film. 'match' lists words in a shot's description that call for this still; 'priority' 1 wins when a shot has more matches than reference slots. A ref is painted when the producer reaches its chapter. Never name a studio, a director or an existing film.

refs.name: style
refs.prompt: Key art. Dusk on the Noto coast, low camera at porch level, close and intimate. An old grandmother and a seven-year-old girl kneel facing each other across a stone rice mortar on a farmhouse porch. The grandmother holds a long wooden mallet in both hands, raised high above her head at the top of its swing; the girl has just pulled her small hands back out of the steaming rice, flour on her nose, laughing. They look only at each other; the grandmother smiles with softly glistening eyes, as if memorising her face. Warm amber lantern light on the grandmother, cool silver moonlight on the girl. A huge full moon rises over the sea behind them, terraced rice paddies fall away below, the first stars come out. At the edge of the porch one cushion lies empty. Tender, quiet and bittersweet, the last ordinary evening before everything changes. Clean and crisp detail.

refs.name: tsumugi_ch1
refs.prompt: Character sheet of Tsumugi, a seven-year-old Japanese village girl: full body front view, three-quarter view and side view, plus three close-up expressions: laughing with flour on her nose, wide-eyed wonder looking up, and holding back tears. Short black bob with a soft fringe, large dark expressive eyes, small scar-free hands, an indigo sashiko-stitched cotton jacket over a plain cream top, dark trousers, straw sandals. Consistent proportions in every view. Plain warm grey background, even soft studio light.

refs.name: sayo
refs.prompt: Character sheet of Sayo, a Japanese grandmother in her seventies from a rice-and-fishing village: full body front view, three-quarter view and side view, plus three close-up expressions: a gentle crinkled smile, fierce focus while swinging a wooden mallet, and grief held quietly behind calm eyes. Silver hair in a low bun, weathered kind face, strong working hands, a faded indigo work kimono with sleeves tied back by a cord, a plain apron. Consistent proportions in every view. Plain warm grey background, even soft studio light.

refs.name: bowl_ch1
refs.prompt: Still life: a hand-thrown rice bowl with an earthy brown and cream glaze, mended once: a single thin seam of gold kintsugi runs from the rim to the foot. It rests on a worn wooden tray beside a few grains of rice, lit by soft side light through a paper shoji window. Shallow depth of field, intimate and reverent, the gold seam catching the light.

refs.name: farmhouse_ch1
refs.prompt: Environment establishing shot, no people: an old thatched farmhouse with a wide wooden engawa porch on the Noto peninsula at dusk. Terraced rice paddies step down to the Sea of Japan, a stone mortar and wooden mallet rest on the porch, paper lanterns are lit, pampas grass sways, the full moon hangs low over the water. Peaceful, nostalgic, a home worth remembering.

refs.name: hearth_ch1
refs.prompt: Environment, no people: the inside of the same old farmhouse at night in winter. A sunken irori hearth with a low fire, a hanging kettle, tatami, sliding paper screens glowing faintly, a lacquered tray of small dishes set before an empty floor cushion. Warm firelight against blue snow-light from the windows. Quiet, sacred, expectant.
